offering_description.value: Operates wholesale auctions and an online marketplace where dealers, lenders and leasing companies buy and sell used vehicles, and provides dealer floorplan financing. It earns fees from sellers and buyers and runs physical sites and digital platforms across North America.

primary_products.value: used vehicles; off-lease vehicles; repossessed vehicles; fleet vehicles

primary_services.value: vehicle auction services; online vehicle remarketing; dealer floorplan financing; vehicle reconditioning; vehicle logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchised and independent auto dealers, auto lenders, leasing companies, rental fleets

end_markets.value: automotive retail; vehicle finance; vehicle leasing; fleet management

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: auction and marketplace fees paid by sellers and buyers per vehicle sold; interest or premiums: interest on dealer floorplan financing loans; service fees: reconditioning, transport and title services for vehicles
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace where buyers bid on vehicles from sellers; service provider: runs auctions and vehicle remarketing, taking in vehicles from lenders, leasing companies and rental fleets, selling to dealers; financial intermediary: provides floorplan loans to dealers to finance vehicle inventory
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: physical and digital vehicle auctions, online remarketing, dealer floorplan financing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: physical auction sites across North America; online: digital marketplace for remote bidding on vehicles

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state auto dealer and auction licensing, title and vehicle transfer rules, consumer finance regulations for floorplan lending

notes: Business mix, site counts and geographic footprint are from general knowledge and may have changed.
